name: CLIENT_ID
label: OAuth 2.0 Client ID
help: X bills every API request to this app's prepaid credits, so the app's owner pays for every user's reads and posts. Posts containing a link cost more than other posts.
setupSteps: In the X Developer Console, create a Project and an App.
Under User authentication settings, enable OAuth 2.0 with the type "Web App, Automated App or Bot" and the permission "Read and write".
Set the Callback URI to the value below, and give the app a website URL.
Buy credits and set a spending limit: X bills every request this app makes.
X requires its prior approval before an app posts AI-generated replies; replies drafted by agents are sent only once a user approves each one, but the obligation is the app owner's.
Copy the OAuth 2.0 Client ID and Client Secret here.
